findings.discovery_effort: Moderate-to-high. Card payment methods and the Affirm/Citi-card promotions are easy to find (footer link, dedicated brand pages, cart cross-sell). But EBT/SNAP and HSA/FSA/OTC eligibility require a shopper to already know to visit a separate customer-service FAQ or the Pharmacy microsite, or to search the exact phrase 'fsa eligible' — none of this is surfaced through standard category browsing, filters, or the cart. Membership-gating economics (5% non-member surcharge, 'Members Only'/'Sign In for Details' pricing lock) are likewise disclosed only via secondary FAQ pages, not inline at the point of shopping.

eligibility_indicators.description: Grocery search results show only logistics badges (2-Day Delivery, Delivery Available, Buy in Warehouse, Warehouse Only) with no benefit badges. Health search results show 'Members Only' and 'Online Only' badges plus item promos, but no FSA/HSA badge unless searching the literal phrase 'fsa eligible'. When found (via costco.com/s?keyword=fsa%20eligible, ~222-305 items), items carry a blue 'FSA Eligible' badge on both search cards and PDPs (confirmed on 'Kirkland Signature Aller-Tec, 365 Tablets', which shows 'FSA Eligible' above the title and again as an 'FSA Eligible' tab in Specifications). There is no dedicated filter checkbox for FSA/HSA/EBT/OTC in the search filter sidebar (only Category, Delivery Location, My Warehouse, Price, Member Reviews, Brand, Form, Lifestage, Body Area), so a shopper does not know eligibility before checkout unless they already know to search for it or land on the Pharmacy partner page.

Home page, footer, and PDP carry zero payment-method badges, card-network icons, or BNPL/installment copy (confirmed via text search for 'installment', 'as low as', 'Afterpay', 'Affirm', 'Klarna' on the PDP — all absent). findings.discovery_effort: Learning payment/benefit eligibility pre-checkout requires moderate effort: EBT/SNAP eligibility is discoverable via a search filter chip and a 'Accepts EBT' store badge, but FSA/HSA and OTC eligibility are not surfaced with on-product badges in the Costco storefront and instead require reading separate Help Center articles (Shopping with FSA and HSA; Shopping with your OTC Network card) or landing pages (instacart.com/p/fsa-hsa) rather than being obvious in the shopping flow itself.
